title: Radar Positioning System – Kotlin App with RESTful Backend
description: Stay informed of speed cameras around you – anywhere in France. This mobile app lets you locate speed cameras near your current location or anywhere across the country.
tasks: Developed a REST API to fetch the locations of speed cameras across France.
Built a mobile front-end in Kotlin, integrating Google Maps API to display radar positions on an interactive map.
Deployed the backend on Clever Cloud for scalable and reliable hosting.
